facts.content: Patient presents with lip swelling after prawn consumption.
facts.source_text: CC: Lip swelling after prawn consumption

facts.content: Lip swelling began approximately 30 minutes after ingestion of prawn soup.
facts.source_text: Lip swelling began ~30 min post-prawn soup ingestion

facts.content: The swelling was associated with difficulty breathing.
The swelling was associated with chest tightness.
facts.source_text: associated w/ difficulty breathing, chest tightness

facts.content: Patient has a history of asthma.
Patient has a peanut allergy with a history of severe allergic reaction requiring a hospital visit.
facts.source_text: Peanut allergy (history of severe allergic reaction requiring hospital visit)

facts.content: Patient uses antihistamines of unknown type.
Patient had no alcohol intake at the time of the latest reaction.
facts.source_text: SH: No etOH at time of latest reaction

facts.content: No objective findings were recorded in the examination.
Acute lip swelling occurred after ingestion of prawns.
facts.source_text: Acute lip swelling post-ingestion of prawns

facts.content: The suspected anaphylaxis is associated with respiratory symptoms including difficulty breathing and chest tightness.
facts.source_text: Associated respiratory symptoms (difficulty breathing, chest tightness)

facts.content: Immediate call to emergency services by ambulance was planned for possible anaphylaxis.
